authority: This file owns archive URL, digest, size and retention metadata. tools/evidence_inventory.json references this file; it does not duplicate these fields.

archive.trial_ids: Every id in results/trials.jsonl; id stem names an archived results JSON and suffix is its JSON Pointer. Repeated configurations retain distinct source offsets.

verification.offline: python tools/validate_evidence.py checks manifest digests and layout without downloading; absent archive content remains explicitly unavailable.
verification.comparison: Exact derived JSON values and counts; HTTP medians exactly recomputed from stored samples. Recorded image-score aggregates do not rerun image validators.
verification.archive_safety: Authenticate bytes and SHA-256 before bounded in-memory reading. No archived code execution or filesystem extraction. Reject links, devices, duplicate/unsafe paths; cap files, expanded bytes and elapsed time.

availability_limits: This archive preserves only the already public export; no private artifacts were added.
Most original images, activation tensors, historical candidate source snapshots and host/profiler logs were not published and remain unavailable for independent replay.
Six representative full-resolution round-two PNGs are archived; the other 24 images in that numerical screen are not included.
Source digests in historical source-manifest files identify external snapshots and are not verification of those unavailable source bytes.
Final ABBA, full visual acceptance and cross-hardware reference quality remain incomplete; all latency targets remain unmet.
